map.输入密码实时评估安全强度。从字符种类、长度、复杂度、常见模式多维度分析，估算破解: Enter a password for real-time security strength assessment. Character classes, length, complexity and common patterns are analysed multidimensionally, crack time estimated and improvement suggested. Passwords are processed locally only and never uploaded.

map.按字符集大小评估：仅数字、加字母、再加符号，熵呈对数增长。: Evaluate by character set size: digits only, plus letters, plus symbols — entropy grows logarithmically.
map.对照目标安全等级（如 60 bit 以上）给出改进建议。: Give improvement suggestions against a target security level (e.g. above 60 bit).
map.：口令熵（bit）= 长度 × log2(字符池大小)。字符池：纯数字 10、加: : password entropy (bit) = length × log2(character pool size). Pool: 10 for digits, 36 with lowercase added, 62 with both cases, about 95 with symbols. The higher the entropy, the harder the brute force; generally ≥ 60 bit is advised and ≥ 80 bit for high security.
map.：8 位纯数字：8×log2(10)≈26.6 bit（很弱）；8 位大小写+数: : 8 digits, digits only: 8×log2(10)≈26.6 bit (very weak); 8 digits with mixed case and digits: 8×log2(62)≈47.6 bit; 12 digits with symbols: 12×log2(95)≈78.6 bit (passing). "password" is long but has a small character pool and is common, so avoid dictionary words.
